title: fix(stats): handle an empty average input
body:
## Rationale
An empty batch currently raises ZeroDivisionError; the reporting contract requires a neutral numeric result for batches with no observations.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Unrelated features remain outside scope; risk assessment is pending.

## Breaking changes
No signature change. Empty input now returns 0 instead of raising ZeroDivisionError, which may affect exception-based callers.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/stats.py b/src/stats.py
--- a/src/stats.py
+++ b/src/stats.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def average(values):
+    if not values:
+        return 0
     return sum(values) / len(values)

diff --git a/tests/test_stats.py b/tests/test_stats.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_stats.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.stats import average
+
+
+def test_average():
+    assert average([]) == 0
+    assert average([2, 4]) == 3
